_: Hand trims on the source takes. in: start later (seconds into the take). endAtWord: drop everything after that word. tail: seconds of air kept after the last word (default 0.32) — raised where an overlay needs its hold (MOTION-SYSTEM.md §3) and the take has the air to give (data/takes.json has the take lengths; B1-12 has 0.9 s before the sentence Faisal cut, so 0.7 keeps that cut clean).
